request: At DeleteSpaceMember handler entry, compare removal of the caller's own active membership with removal of a different active member's membership in the same space. Assume resource resolution succeeds. Report source-visible authorization and the accepted-policy comparison separately.

policySources.text: An active space member may delete their own membership to leave. Removing a different active member requires space administrator authority.

acceptance.reason: This is the accepted original policy supplied by the task author.

resources.description: Author facts: ["Selected space with an active membership target","Resource resolution succeeds"]

scopeAssurance: Only explicitly declared scenarios and supplied source are assessed; repository discovery and deployment behavior are not tested.
requiredAnalysis: Trace entry, identity and resource binding, strongest authorization control, and protected effect. Explain decisive missing source-external facts.
constraints: Use only supplied fixed source context. Do not execute or modify the target, contact a deployment, or claim repository-wide discovery.
